# SQL conventions

- Lowercase identifiers, uppercase SQL keywords, two-space indent, one clause per line for anything longer than one line.
- Always schema-qualify tables (`olist.orders`). Always use explicit `JOIN ... ON`; no comma joins.
- Name constraints and indexes: `<table>_<columns>_idx`, `<table>_<columns>_fkey`, `<table>_pkey`.
- Add a short comment on top of every query file saying what it answers and which tables it reads.
- Queries that return lists end with `ORDER BY` and `LIMIT`. Never `SELECT *` in saved queries.
- Money columns are `numeric(10,2)`; never `float`.
- Never commit a statement that changes data or schema outside `db/migrations/`.
